notes.detail: Not applied. Marking 5ZU not available leaves no orderable high-wing spoiler (5ZW and 5ZZ are already not available), so 5V7 Black Ground Effects, which requires 5ZU, 5ZW or 5ZZ, could no longer be built and the editor refuses the change. Choose: mark 5V7 not available as well and retire its spoiler requirement and conflicts (history keeps them), or keep 5ZU orderable until the manufacturer restores it.
ZR1X HP1 already reads 186 hp, 145 lb-ft and 1250 hp total combined with the LT7; ZR1 has no HP1. No change.
ZTK already requires and adds TOM (owner decision ZR1-D06); "Included with PCR" is carried by the PCR proposals. The ZTK footnote copy is owner wording and is left as is.
No direct PDA/SHT conflict, but PDA includes SNE and VPW and both conflict with SHT, so the pair cannot be built.
Fleet OnStar/API options are not in the customer catalog.
Emissions overrides (NB8, NB9, NC7) are not in the customer catalog.
Dimensions and specifications are not in the catalog.
